correctness.notes: oracle passed on every measured cell | 74 cells reported unsupported by the adapter's supported(), listed in correctness.unsupported_cells | 162 cells dropped for lack of a control value (a cell-list batch run under the other requirement carries the same cells without the reference's path, their twins with a control are in the card), for example N1024 k4 bf16 prefer_smaller_index latency | phase 3 final evaluation, harness 0.10, 0.11, nodes umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094 | cells come from more than one node, see the node field of every cell: umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094

low_level: Registers 30 to 255 over the 593 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (33 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 2144 to 39040 bytes, harness 0.10, 0.11 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068, umbriel-b200-094.
Adapter statics: input arrangement striped, output indices, temp storage 2112 to 6272 bytes.
Oracle battery (23 cases per cell plus the measurement seeds) passed on every cell that has a number, 74 cells unsupported by the adapter's contract or the device, no cell failed the oracle.
algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 0 of 56 cells (runner-up in 4), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 2 of 55 cells (runner-up in 10), throughput not_guaranteed wins 11 of 63 cells (runner-up in 25), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 16 of 55 cells (runner-up in 9).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 1024, bf16 N 4096, fp32 N 1024, fp32 N 2048, fp32 N 4096, fp32 N 8192), the median margin over the runner-up is +2 percent and over the scope's reference control +41 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): bf16 N 16384 k 4 +994 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, fp32 N 16384 k 4 +465 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 1024 k 4 +416 percent behind B2_packed@T128 in latency prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +404 percent behind B2_twolevel in latency prefer_smaller_index.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 0 of 53 cells (runner-up in 8), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 0 of 36 cells (runner-up in 8), throughput not_guaranteed wins 13 of 53 cells (9 as B1_det2, 3 as B1_det2@T512, 1 as B1_det2@T128, runner-up in 10), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 36 cells (runner-up in 12).

Shuffled tie-heavy input (harness 0.11, umbriel-b200-094): latency not_guaranteed wins 0 of 33 cells (runner-up in 1), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 0 of 33 cells (runner-up in 5), throughput not_guaranteed wins 3 of 33 cells (2 as B1_det2, 1 as B1_det2@T512, runner-up in 12), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 3 of 33 cells (runner-up in 6).

Named workloads won on random input: dsa_small_context_8k_k2048, dsa_v32_merge_m4_k2048, dsa_v4_merge_m8_k1024, ec_e128_c1, h2o_cache_4096_20pct, mod_12p5_4096, quest_pages_32k_budget2048, sampling_chunk_4k_k64.
negative: No cell where this adapter was the winner changed hands against the control in the same lock section. Deficits above are against other adapters of the same scope.
surprises: In throughput B1_det2 and B1_idx tie within 0.1 percent on most N 1024 cells (the deterministic rank costs nothing there), the matrix lists whichever was marginally faster.
